1422. Java Dynamic Library System

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Design a dynamic library system in Java where books can be added, borrowed, and returned. Each book should have a title, author, and a unique ID. Implement appropriate methods in a Library class to manage these operations. You need to define a class Book and a class Library with the following specifications: Book class: Member variables title, author, bookID (all strings) Library class: Member variables: a list to store Book objects Methods: addBook, borrowBook, returnBook Implement a mechanism to ensure a book cannot be borrowed more than once without being returned
input_spec: The first input will be a sequence of commands (add, borrow, return) followed by the details of the book. For add: title author bookID For borrow and return: bookID
output_spec: Appropriate success or error messages for each operation.

samples.output:
Book added successfully.
Book returned successfully.
